name: AutomationDirect LR-10P2-1PH line reactor
summary: LR-10P2-1PH line reactor arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: LR-10P2-1PH is the drawing identifier for line reactor in AutomationDirect's AC Line Reactors (LR Series) collection. A line reactor is an inductive component used in the selected power circuit. A layout drawing describes its physical installation, while the electrical design establishes its required application and rating.

For example, in a motor-drive panel with a separately selected reactor, use the LR-10P2-1PH reference to coordinate power-conductor approach, mounting fasteners and adjacent heat-sensitive equipment. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Drives-Motors-Motion/GS and Durapulse AC Drives/AC Line Reactors/LR-10P2-1PH.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep power-conductor approach, mounting fasteners and adjacent heat-sensitive equipment visible in the layout.
